S002.name: Sustained_Attention_Difficulty
S002.description: Often has difficulty sustaining attention in tasks or play activities.
examples: Focuses at first during class or meetings but soon becomes distracted or spaces out.
Re-reads the same paragraph in a book multiple times but the content does not register.
Loses focus while watching movies or TV and misses the plot.
Unable to maintain attention until the end of a long meeting or lecture, often drifting off or becoming drowsy.

S004.name: Instruction_Follow through_Difficulty
S004.description: Often does not follow through on instructions and fails to finish schoolwork, chores, or duties in the workplace.
examples: Starts homework or projects but fails to complete them, submitting unfinished work or missing deadlines.
When given multi-step instructions, follows only the first few steps and forgets the rest.
Starts cleaning or organizing but switches to another task midway, failing to finish.
Leaves almost completed work reports or paperwork unfinished, neglecting the final steps.

S005.name: Organization_Difficulty
S005.description: Often has difficulty organizing tasks and activities.
examples: Desk, bag, or room is always messy and remains disorganized.
Unable to prioritize or determine the order of tasks, starting them randomly.
Fails to plan time effectively, frequently missing deadlines or rushing to finish at the last minute.
Feels overwhelmed by how to start multi-step projects and procrastinates.

S010.name: Fidgeting
S010.description: Often fidgets with or taps hands or feet or squirms in seat.
examples: Constantly shaking legs or twisting and squirming body while seated.
Spinning a pen or fiddling with nearby objects, unable to keep hands still.
Continually changing posture and feeling uncomfortable while sitting.
Constantly moving, such as tapping the desk with fingers or tapping feet on the floor.

S011.name: Leaving_Seat
S011.description: Often leaves seat in situations when remaining seated is expected.
examples: Frequently leaves seat or wanders around during class or meetings using excuses.
Unable to sit still during meals and keeps getting up.
Leaves seat in the middle of a movie or performance to go to the restroom or go outside.
Continually leaves seat and wanders around in the office where one is expected to sit and work.

S012.name: Feeling_Restless
S012.description: Often runs about or climbs in situations where it is inappropriate. (Note: In adolescents or adults, may be limited to feeling restless.)
examples: Feels uncomfortable and restless as if something is squirming inside when sitting still.
Feels internally anxious and stifled in situations requiring prolonged sitting.
A sense of urgency and anxiety that one must keep moving or doing something.
Feels unable to endure staying still and must constantly be doing something.

S016.name: Blurting_Answers
S016.description: Often blurts out an answer before a question has been completed.
examples: Raises hand or blurts out the answer before the question is even finished in class or meetings.
Jumps to conclusions and speaks before the other person finishes their sentence.
Answers hastily without reading the question to the end in quizzes or exams.
Interrupts and answers in the middle of a conversation without listening to the other person until the end.

S017.name: Waiting_Turn_Difficulty
S017.description: Often has difficulty waiting his or her turn.
examples: Cannot wait and cuts in line or gets impatient when standing in a queue.
Rushes or cuts in without waiting for their turn in games or board games.
Keeps checking the time or complaining when waiting for their turn at hospitals or public offices.
Fidgets, complains, or gets annoyed in situations where waiting for a turn is required.

info.persona: Cathleen Ache is a curious, competitively driven 21‑year‑old who balances DIY creativity with financial caution, yet often wrestles with worry and a habit of over‑committing to projects at the expense of organized planning.
info.professional_persona: A budding e‑commerce entrepreneur, Cathleen Ache blends DIY home‑decor craftsmanship with basic video editing and social‑media savvy, channeling their skeptical eye for trends into a flexible, sometimes chaotic schedule as they work toward a business administration degree and launch a handcrafted accessories shop.
info.cultural_background: Cathleen is a white New Englander raised in Durham, NH, with family roots tracing back to English and Irish ancestry. Growing up in a small, tight‑knit community, she internalized the region’s pragmatic values, love for seasonal traditions, and emphasis on self‑reliance. Local customs such as town fairs, community volunteer projects, and a strong outdoor culture have shaped her appreciation for both independence and modest communal engagement.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Cathleen spends her free time exploring indie video games, hiking the scenic trails around Durham and the broader Rockingham County, and experimenting with new recipes in the kitchen, especially comfort foods with a twist. She enjoys sketching nature scenes in a small notebook, attending local open‑mic nights to hear poetry and acoustic sets, and curling up with science‑fiction novels that satisfy her curiosity. When she needs a mental reset, she practices guided breathing and journaling to manage stress.
info.sports_persona: A nature‑focused hiker, Cathleen Ache spends weekends trekking the scenic trails around Durham and Rockingham County, follows the Carolina Panthers for football season, and occasionally joins a local recreational soccer league, though they often skip scheduled workouts when overwhelmed by academic pressures.
info.arts_persona: A creative explorer, Cathleen Ache sketches trail vistas in a pocket notebook, immerses themselves in indie game narratives like "Hades", frequents local open‑mic nights to hear poet Rupi Kaur and acoustic covers of Sufjan Stevens, and reads sci‑fi works by N.K. Jemisin, allowing their competitive board‑gaming spirit to fuel collaborative art projects.
info.travel_persona: A spontaneous road‑trip planner, Cathleen Ache enjoys budget-friendly weekend escapes to nearby national parks such as "Shenandoah" and "Great Smoky Mountains", dreams of backpacking through Japan’s countryside to combine hiking with indie‑game cafés, and balances travel ambitions with the financial constraints of a college student budget.
info.culinary_persona: An experimental home cook, Cathleen Ache loves reinventing comfort foods by adding unexpected twists—like truffle‑infused mac and cheese, kimchi‑topped grilled cheese, and sweet potato ramen—and sources fresh ingredients at local farmers’ markets while documenting recipes in a handwritten journal.

info.persona: Edgar Shlesinger, a 36‑year‑old community‑oriented multitasker, they balance a love for soccer, Folklorico, and garden‑fresh tacos with persistent financial anxiety that fuels meticulous budgeting but often leads to late‑night snack indulgences.
info.professional_persona: Edgar Shlesinger, a 36‑year‑old aspiring community‑center aide, they leverage bilingual communication, hands‑on repair skills, and meticulous budget‑tracking to streamline pantry logistics while satisfying a curiosity for new organizational methods and maintaining a reliable, pragmatic work ethic.
info.cultural_background: Edgar’s Mexican heritage is a central part of his identity. Growing up in Tulare’s vibrant Hispanic community, he blends Mexican traditions—such as Catholic celebrations, family‑centered meals, and community festivals—with the realities of life in California’s agricultural heartland. He speaks Spanish at home, celebrates holidays like Día de los Muertos and Cinco de Mayo, and values family cohesion, respect for elders, and mutual support, all of which shape his worldview and daily practices.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In his free time, Edgar enjoys playing pickup soccer with friends, dancing Folklorico at local festivals, and experimenting with new twists on classic Mexican recipes. He maintains a modest backyard garden where he grows tomatoes, chilies, and herbs, and he regularly volunteers at his church’s food pantry, helping organize meals and community gatherings. He also likes listening to regional banda music, watching Liga MX matches, and playing Lotería with family.
info.sports_persona: Edgar Shlesinger, a devoted soccer enthusiast, they join Saturday morning pickup games at the community park, cheer on Club América and Tigres UANL during Liga MX broadcasts, belong to the local Friends United FC recreational league, and maintain fitness through light jogging and post‑game stretching, while occasionally hitting the gym for cross‑training.
info.arts_persona: Edgar Shlesinger, an energetic Folklorico dancer at regional festivals, they find inspiration in the brass‑driven rhythms of Banda El Recodo and La Arrolladora Banda, admire the cinematic storytelling of Guillermo del Toro, and appreciate the vivid murals of Diego Rivera, weaving these artistic influences into community gatherings and cooking sessions.
info.travel_persona: Edgar Shlesinger, who prefers weekend road trips to nearby Hill Country vineyards and has explored Oaxaca’s bustling markets, they dream of strolling through San Miguel de Allende’s colonial plazas, balance travel planning with a spreadsheet to stay within a modest family budget, and enjoy spontaneous detours that lead to hidden taco stands.
info.culinary_persona: Edgar Shlesinger, a passionate home cook, they reinvent classic carnitas tacos with a splash of pineapple and chipotle, perfect tamales de rajas wrapped in corn husks, craft occasional chiles en nogada for special occasions, and rely on heirloom tomatoes, jalapeños, and fresh cilantro harvested from their backyard garden to ensure authentic flavor.

info.persona: Cathy Floyd navigates life with a pragmatic Midwestern backbone and a desert‑inspired curiosity, leading tech teams by day, snapping murals by night, and they habitually forget to water their indoor cactus until the next board‑game night.
info.professional_persona: Cathy Floyd is a senior full‑stack software engineer who leverages fifteen years of Python, Java, and React expertise to craft cloud‑native solutions, and blends Midwestern pragmatism with an open‑minded curiosity to lead agile teams, champion user‑centered design, and mentor junior developers toward continuous learning; they thrive on turning complex problems into elegant code.
info.cultural_background: Cathy is a fourth-generation white American with Irish and German ancestry. Raised in the Midwest before moving to Arizona for her career, she blends Midwestern pragmatism with the vibrant, outdoor-oriented culture of the Southwest. Living in Phoenix, she embraces the region’s love for desert recreation, appreciates Native American and Hispanic artistic influences, and participates in multicultural events such as Cinco de Mayo celebrations and local art festivals. Her upbringing emphasized community involvement and a strong work ethic, which she carries into both her professional and personal life.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Outside of work, Cathy indulges her curiosity through a blend of artistic and outdoor pursuits. She regularly explores Phoenix’s art scene, attending gallery openings and street-art tours, and practices photography to capture desert landscapes and urban murals. She enjoys group activities like board-game evenings, weekend hikes in the Sonoran Desert, and community hackathons. An avid traveler, she seeks out cultural festivals that celebrate music, food, and performance art. She also practices yoga for mindfulness, experiments with fusion cooking at home, and volunteers as a coding mentor for local youth programs.
info.sports_persona: Cathy Floyd is a devoted fan of the Phoenix Suns and Arizona Diamondbacks, participates in weekend hikes with the Desert Trailblazers club, and attends monthly group yoga sessions at a downtown studio; they balance high‑intensity interval training in the winter with desert trail runs in the cooler evenings.
info.arts_persona: Cathy Floyd immerses herself in Phoenix’s thriving art scene, snapping photos of vibrant murals by local creator ‘Moejay’, attending gallery openings that showcase works reminiscent of Georgia O’Keeffe, and curating playlists that swing from the indie folk of The Staves to the desert‑rock fusion of Calexico; they also occasionally quote lines from the films of Greta Gerwig.
info.travel_persona: Cathy Floyd prefers a blend of purposeful itinerary and spontaneous detours, having trekked the Sonoran Desert, explored the lantern‑lit streets of Kyoto, savored street tacos in Oaxaca during a Day of the Dead celebration, and camped under the Midnight Sun in Iceland, while budgeting future trips to Patagonia’s Torres del Paine and the historic trails of the Silk Road; they plan each adventure with a mix of research and open‑ended curiosity.
info.culinary_persona: Cathy Floyd cooks at an intermediate level, regularly whipping up fusion dishes like quinoa‑infused chili topped with cilantro‑lime crema, grilled trout with Argentine chimichurri, and Sonoran hot dogs drizzled with jalapeño mayo, while relishing tacos al pastor and experimenting with smoked paprika, but they sometimes over‑spice in their enthusiasm for bold flavors.
